**Management Summary – Project LV €4,650**

The tender contains critical specification gaps that jeopardize cost control and compliance. High‑risk items (total €495) lack mandatory technical data for foundation works (concrete class, strength, reinforcement) and suffer encoding errors that corrupt key terms, risking mis‑searches and mis‑bids. Medium‑risk deficiencies (total €450) omit depth, soil type, and extent for top‑soil removal, while the site‑setup package is missing a dedicated BO position, exposing quantity changes to VOB/B § 2 Abs. 3 disputes. A low‑risk issue is the absent long description for a line item. Immediate actions: (1) revise all short/long texts to include full technical parameters; (2) correct file encoding; (3) add a separate BO entry for site facilities; (4) re‑issue the corrected LV before bid submission.
